scope: Offline parse package only, not installed; no game object writes. Parent executes only after actual Kaishek static acceptance.

commands.command: effect log = "R7NP_A_ROOT" if = { limit = { exists = event_target:eep_core0 } log = "R7NP_A_CORE_EXISTS" } event_target:eep_core0 = { log = "R7NP_A_CORE [This.GetName]" solar_system = { log = "R7NP_A_SYSTEM [This.GetName]" every_system_planet = { log = "R7NP_A_EACH [This.GetName]" } random_system_planet = { log = "R7NP_A_RANDOM [This.GetName]" } } } log = "R7NP_A_END"

effect event_target:eep_core0 = { solar_system = { every_system_planet = { if = { limit = { is_colony = no } log = "R7NP_B_C0 [This.GetName]" } if = { limit = { NOT = { is_colony = yes } } log = "R7NP_B_CN [This.GetName]" } if = { limit = { is_under_colonization = no } log = "R7NP_B_U0 [This.GetName]" } if = { limit = { NOT = { is_under_colonization = yes } } log = "R7NP_B_UN [This.GetName]" } if = { limit = { is_star = no } log = "R7NP_B_S0 [This.GetName]" } if = { limit = { is_artificial = no } log = "R7NP_B_A0 [This.GetName]" } } } }

effect event_target:eep_core0 = { solar_system = { every_system_planet = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_carrier_flag = eep_core } } log = "R7NP_C_K0 [This.GetName]" } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_carrier_flag = eep_guard_reserved } } log = "R7NP_C_R0 [This.GetName]" } if = { limit = { is_colony = no is_under_colonization = no is_star = no is_artificial = no NOT = { has_carrier_flag = eep_core } NOT = { has_carrier_flag = eep_guard_reserved } } log = "R7NP_C_PASS [This.GetName]" } } random_system_planet = { limit = { is_colony = no is_under_colonization = no is_star = no is_artificial = no NOT = { has_carrier_flag = eep_core } NOT = { has_carrier_flag = eep_guard_reserved } } log = "R7NP_C_RANDOM_PASS [This.GetName]" } } }

static_acceptance.scope: syntax/package including supported fixed weapon CSV paths, literal planet-killer numeric sources and callback existence plus explicitly registered finite population scopes and referenced script-value shapes only; native loading, phase timing, runtime, recursive expansion and other opcodes require Stellaris tests
